name: Sticker Maker & GIFs - Peely
subtitle: Photo Cutouts & Postcards
description:
Turn your photos into personal stickers with Peely, a sticker maker for iPhone and iPad. Cut out people, pets and favorite objects, customize every detail, and build a collection that feels like you.

MAKE STICKERS FROM PHOTOS
Remove the background and keep subjects together or cut them out separately. Photo cutout processing happens on your device. Use the eraser to refine your sticker and restore details from the original cutout.

YOUR OWN STICKER EDITOR
Add outlines and borders, layer text and drawings, and arrange a custom sticker composition. Organize your creations in folders, save favorites and keep your sticker collection easy to find.

ANIMATED STICKERS AND GIFS
With Peely Plus, turn videos and GIFs into animated stickers. Trim a short loop, preview the motion and remove the background when needed. Share your creations as animated GIFs or transparent PNG files.

STICKER PACKS FOR iMESSAGE
Use Peely Plus to access your selected sticker folders in Messages. Export a Peely folder as a sticker pack that another Peely user can import, or share your creations through the system share sheet.

PERSONAL DIGITAL POSTCARDS
Combine photos, stickers and text on a two-sided digital postcard. With Peely Plus, export both sides as images or a flipping GIF to send someone a small, personal surprise.

FREE TO START, MORE WITH PLUS
Create up to 7 stickers for free. Peely Plus is required for additional sticker creation, sharing and exports, animated imports, Messages sticker packs, premium effects, selected card templates and watched photo albums.

Album features require Photos access. Watched albums update when you return to Peely and when iOS permits background work. iCloud photo originals may require an internet connection.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Rezonating Apps, LLC provides Peely, a sticker maker for iPhone and iPad. This policy explains how Peely handles your content, permissions, optional iCloud synchronization, purchases, and support requests.

sections.title: Your Photos and Creations
sections.content: Peely processes photo cutouts and background removal on your device. Imported media, stickers, folders, user-assigned people names, favorites, card drafts, and editing preferences are stored locally to provide the app’s features. Peely does not upload your media to a developer-operated server for cutout processing. People groups are named and assigned by you; Peely does not infer identities or read the Photos People database.

sections.title: Permissions and Photo Albums
sections.content: Peely accesses the photos and albums you authorize to import media and create stickers. Camera access lets you take a photo for a sticker; permission to add to Photos lets you save creations. Device motion is used for postcard tilt effects. You can change permissions in device Settings. Limited Photos access restricts the available library. Watched albums check for new photos when you return to the app and when iOS allows background processing. Downloading originals stored in iCloud Photos may involve Apple’s services and require an internet connection.

sections.title: Optional iCloud Sync and Backups
sections.content: If you enable iCloud sync, Peely sends sticker images and library information, including collections and user-assigned people groups, to your Apple account’s private CloudKit database to synchronize your library. The app stores an iCloud account identifier locally to detect account changes. Sync is optional and can be disabled in Peely. Disabling sync stops future synchronization; it does not by itself erase previously uploaded data. Apple manages iCloud storage and any device backups you enable under its own policies.

sections.title: Sharing and Extensions
sections.content: Peely’s Share and Messages extensions use shared storage on your device to receive imports and make selected sticker folders available in Messages. When you export or share stickers, animated GIFs, postcards, or .peely packs, your chosen destination and recipients receive that content. Exported packs can include names and organization information. Review what you share; recipient copies and other apps are outside our control. Peely does not need access to your message history to provide its sticker extension.

sections.title: Purchases and RevenueCat
sections.content: Apple handles App Store payments. Peely uses RevenueCat to validate purchases, restore access, deliver paywalls, and manage Peely Plus entitlements. RevenueCat processes purchase history, subscription status, a generated app user identifier, and technical information needed for its service. Purchase information is also used for subscription reporting and analytics. We do not receive your full payment card details. Peely does not send your sticker library or imported photos to RevenueCat. RevenueCat’s privacy information is available at https://www.revenuecat.com/privacy.

sections.title: Advertising and Tracking
sections.content: Peely does not sell your personal content or use it for targeted advertising. The reviewed app does not include an advertising SDK or request an advertising tracking identifier. Purchase reporting through RevenueCat is separate from your photo library and sticker content.

sections.title: Support
sections.content: If you email team@rezonating.app, we receive your email address and the information you choose to include, such as your message, device details, or screenshots. We use that information to respond and troubleshoot. Please avoid sending private photos or other sensitive material unless needed for your request.

sections.title: Retention, Deletion, and Your Choices
sections.content: Local content remains until you delete it or remove the app, subject to copies held in backups or shared extension storage. You can delete creations in Peely, revoke permissions in Settings, and disable iCloud sync. iCloud data and backups may remain after uninstalling; manage them through Apple’s iCloud storage controls where available. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription or erase purchase records held by Apple or RevenueCat. Shared recipient copies cannot be recalled by Peely. Contact us to request access, correction, or deletion of support or purchase-related information we can identify, subject to applicable retention requirements.

sections.title: Security and Children
sections.content: Peely uses iOS storage protections and Apple’s private CloudKit database for optional sync. No storage or transmission method is completely secure. Peely does not require a developer account or knowingly solicit personal information from children through account registration. A parent or guardian can contact us about information a child has sent to support.

sections.title: Changes and Contact
sections.content: We may update this policy as Peely changes and will update the date on this page. Questions about privacy or data requests can be sent to Rezonating Apps, LLC at team@rezonating.app.
